Gojo · Experiment review

Error and learning progress

8 paired seeds · 65,536 world tasks · four fixed controllers

The signed-progress controller has lower observed mean net return than error alone: -0.418 resource units per task. Both primary comparisons and their seed variation are shown below.

Full report · Protocol · Mechanism
What is being tested

All four arms observe the same kind of local evidence. The new gate is fixed and authored. It uses recent progress to decide when a finite investigation may continue. Currency prices are abstract; the passive monitor is included in the existing one-unit inspection price.

Inspect one actual run

First seed 800. Source names and phase labels here are analyst descriptions; services receive neither. The decision snapshot reads previous completed blocks and current funding, before this step's feedback.

Each point is one completed comparison version. Missing error points mean open evidence. Error change 128 means 25 points less mismatch; coverage change 128 means 50 points more supported predictions. Adjacent versions can share a block and are not independent tests.

Open advice is not an estimated zero. A zero progress reading means a supported comparison found no change; an open reading means that comparison did not establish a number. An unpurchased event has no new paid decision.

The permission rules

Cold start permits at most 16 actual paid grants. A fresh qualifying block comparison can open one continuation of at most four grants. The signed arm admits improving error with nonfalling coverage, or a sufficient gain in supported answers. The diagnostic arm also treats worsening error as bounded interest. The cycle arm withdraws those progress signals.

Finite four-grant retests occur on the configured 8-inspection cycle; ordinary settled low-error learning keeps its existing schedule. Models and observers can survive cooldown. A service still needs funded acquisition and learning; progress does not mint currency.

Both blocks contain 16 admitted bought physical outcomes, including open predictions. Numeric error requires at least eight known losses in each block. The error observation is independent of whether permission was granted. A signal that remains noisy can create a fortunate positive trend; bounded work and the noise control test its practical consequences.

Read-only local review. No network requests or live training. The analyzer checked per-step currency, paired tapes, source hashes, progress window counts and saved native graph behavior within the declared fixture. The report records failures and claim limits.
